caption: Next scene of Picture 1. A medium shot from the front. The same woman stands centered facing forward, holding a stick in her right hand with her left hand extended open, smiling with wide eyes. Behind her a whiteboard and a bulletin board reading "Let your IDEAS BLOOM" are visible. Same place.

Next scene of Picture 1. A medium-wide shot from a low side angle. The same robot climbs across mossy boulders, its limbs stretched wide for balance and its head tilted down looking toward the rocks, with misty water spraying behind it. Same place, higher on the rocks near the water.

Next scene of Picture 1. A close-up over-the-shoulder shot. The same young man is out of focus in the left foreground with his back to camera, facing a new green reptile-man with bandaged head and purple hair who stares back at him. Same place.

Next scene of Picture 1. A medium shot from a low angle. A new heavyset older man with glasses and yellow tie stands center with arm behind head, flanked by a new dark-haired suited man and two new young brown-haired men watching. Ornate ceiling visible above. Same place.

Next scene of Picture 1. A medium shot at eye level. A new tall man with white hair and blue bandana stands on the left looking down with a slight smile, while the same girl on the right looks up at him attentively, wearing a different bandana. Same place.

Next scene of Picture 1. A medium shot from outside at an oblique high angle. The same man is in the foreground on the right holding a phone to his ear and glancing sideways, while the same two girls are seen through the window seated together at the table, one with her mouth open in surprise. Same place, viewed from outside.
